listing.deleteConfirmDescription: The listing, its photos and your contact details will be erased permanently. This cannot be undone.
listing.deactivateConfirmDescription: The listing will stop being visible until you republish it.

publish.title: Publish your listing
publish.dropPin: Drag the marker to the approximate location
publish.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the room or flat, the household, the rules…
publish.photosHint: Up to 8 photos. The first one is required.
publish.successDescription: We will review it manually and it will show on the map once approved. It switches off by itself after 10 days.
publish.emailHint: It will be shown on the listing, like the WhatsApp number.
publish.contactPublicHint: The external link (for example, your ad on another site) is optional.
publish.editLinkEmailed: We also emailed it to you. Keep it: it is the only way to edit your listing.
publish.editLinkSaveIt: Save it now: it is the only way to edit, deactivate or delete your listing.
publish.placeHint: Filled in automatically from the pin. You can correct them.
publish.requiredNote: Fields marked with an asterisk are required; the rest are optional.
publish.contactAtLeastOne: Give at least one public way to reach you: WhatsApp or email. Whatever you put here is visible to anyone viewing the listing.
publish.oneOfTwo: at least one of the two
publish.legalLink: the legal notice and privacy policy
publish.internalEmailHint: It is not published and can differ from the contact email. We send the private link to edit, deactivate or delete your listing here.

legal.title: Legal notice & privacy
legal.intro: MyLloguer is a non-profit classifieds platform for private rentals and shared flats across Spain, run by Global Shapers Valencia.
legal.dataBody: We only process what the service needs: your listing content, including the WhatsApp number and contact email you give (both public); your private email (only used to send you the management link, never published, and it can differ from the contact email); and an encrypted identifier of that link. No account is needed. We do not sell data to third parties. You can delete your listing at any time from your management link: the listing, its photos and your data are erased permanently.
legal.contentBody: Listings are the sole responsibility of their publishers. We moderate listings before publication but cannot guarantee their accuracy.
legal.contactBody: For any question you can write to us at valencia.globalshapers@gmail.com.

manage.title: Manage your listing
manage.saved: Changes saved. We will review the listing again.
manage.pendingHint: Waiting for review. It will show on the map once approved.
manage.expiredHint: This listing has expired. You can republish it and we will review it again.
manage.rejectedHint: Fix what is mentioned and republish it.
